Engineering RFC 0117

SDK Retry Policy

Motivation

Customers report that the SDK gives up too early during regional failovers. The current policy retries 3 times with a fixed 200 ms delay, which is shorter than a typical DNS TTL.

Proposed policy

const policy = {
  maxAttempts: 6,
  backoff: "exponential", // 100ms, 200ms, 400ms...
  jitter: "full",
  retryOn: [429, 502, 503, 504],
};

Delay for attempt n is random(0, min(cap, base × 2n)).

Compatibility

Retries are a load multiplier; budget them.

Questions? Ping #sdk-team.
